description:
Episode 34 of a daily journey through the universe. ☄️

segments.text: Episode thirty-four. Next stop... the asteroid that ended the dinosaurs.
Sixty-six million years ago, an asteroid about ten kilometers wide slammed into what is now Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula.
segments.headline: Yucatán, Mexico

segments.text: It left a crater about one hundred eighty kilometers wide, now buried underground.
The impact threw dust and soot high into the sky, blocking sunlight for years.
segments.headline: Darkness for years

segments.text: About three quarters of all species on Earth died out, including the dinosaurs that couldn't fly.
The birds you see today are descendants of the dinosaurs that survived.
segments.headline: Dinosaurs never fully left
